title: 3 Temple Mistakes Tourists Make in China (Don't Offer 4) | China Travel Expert
description:
Four incense sticks can quietly offend an entire Chinese temple — here are 3 etiquette mistakes first-time visitors make, and the fixes.

Don't step on the raised wooden threshold — it's meant to keep bad luck out. Don't walk through the center door of the main hall; that gate is for the gods, so enter on the right and exit on the left. And never offer four incense sticks: four (四) sounds like "death" (死), so offer three, held in both hands.

🧭 Expert Tip: Three incense sticks, held in both hands and raised to your forehead, then three small bows — that's a respectful visit at almost any Chinese temple.
